verdict.rationale: Exa is fundamentally an API product. It has extensive first-party API docs covering Search, Contents, Websets and the Agent API, plus rate-limit docs, an official JS SDK with code examples, and agent-readable llms.txt and markdown docs. A hands-on user confirms the search API works well, though another reports one incorrect cURL example. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and fully accurate code examples.
